component.name: EASy68K
component.summary: Motorola 68000 Assembler, Simulator and Native Qt6 IDE

description.p: EASy68K is an open-source Motorola 68000 structured macro assembler, simulator, and integrated development environment for Linux.

It features a native Qt6 IDE with real-time assembly, instruction stepping, hardware peripheral emulation (7-segment displays, LEDs, switches, pushbuttons), memory inspection, and 2D graphics support.
Release 5.16.1 includes the native auto-updater and system repository integration.
